name: icr-documentation
description: ICR Docsify site + PDF export for operations and SMEs

scripts.pdf:director: bash -c 'md-to-pdf functional/director-summary.md --stylesheet pdf/style.css && mv -f functional/director-summary.pdf pdf/'
scripts.pdf:overview: bash -c 'md-to-pdf functional/product-overview.md --stylesheet pdf/style.css && mv -f functional/product-overview.pdf pdf/'
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('puppeteer');console.log('PDF: npm run pdf:all (needs Chromium download on first run) or npm run pdf:html (browser print)')}catch(e){}"
